description: This file defines the DataGroupPermissionCollection class, which extends AttributeBag, and provides a method to convert stored permissions into an array structure. The class appears to manage permissions for different data groups within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DataGroupPermissionCollection
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of data group permissions, providing a method to export permissions as an array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the collection of permissions into an array format, with each data group mapped to its permission flags (read, create, update, delete).
